policy.broad: Official unchanged 60 items and Pearson six-profile correlation. No score for partial/flat/near-flat. No broad-score veto on access or specific-interest support.
policy.guidedSupport: At least two distinct legacy task domains plus both defining interests, eligible evidence and no eligible defining No. Role or route choice is not an exclusive veto. Current skill, demographics, mental health and finances are not interest eligibility gates.
policy.expandedSupport: All three independent subject/method/responsibility questions eligible Yes, no eligible No/reviewHold; no broad-score cutoff.
policy.eligible: Own response or medium/high profile inference with nonempty evidence, no reviewHold. Nonselection is not No; unknown/unfamiliar not No.
policy.ranking: Specific support first, then no contrary evidence, then distinct specific domains, distinct task domains, raw correlation, stable ID. Raw-correlation sorting is available. Evidence is never disguised as statistical correlation.
policy.facets: 24 original reflections; paired prompts are one domain. Context for reflection only pending occupation-link validation; never alter official scores or confirm profession.
policy.scope: Field membership filtered before ranking. No cross-field fallback. Every career globally accessible. First12 is pagination, no quota; college filter is explicit user control, no degree bonus.

Lifestyle remains first in the guide, followed by broad interests and open exploration. Budget does not alter correlations/support or block exploration.
